subject: english
title: My Rainy Walk
objective: Express an idea about a personal experience in clear sentences.
introduction: Milo walked home in the rain! Write about what happened, where you were, how you felt, and what you learned.

vocabulary.definition: The event that took place in a personal experience.
The place where a personal experience took place.
The feeling a writer experienced during an event.

items.prompt: Which detail tells where the experience happened?

options.text: A cat sleeps on the mat.
I walked home with my yellow umbrella.

items.explanation: This sentence tells where the experience happened: on the walk home, with a yellow umbrella.

options.text: I felt glad when Dad met me.
A cat sleeps on the mat.

items.explanation: The word glad names the feeling, so this sentence shows how the writer felt.

items.prompt: Which sentence tells what was learned?

I learned to check the sky before leaving.

items.explanation: Checking the sky is the lesson the writer learned from the rainy-day walk.
